segments.text:
V. 20.
This cup is the New Teſtament—Here is an undeniable Figure, whereby the Cup is put for the Wine in the Cup. And this is called, The New Teſtament in Chriſt's blood, which could not poſſibly mean, that it was the New Teſtament itſelf, but only the Seal of it, and the Sign of that Blood which was ſhed to confirm it.
